verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party statement that Llama accepts image, audio, or document input. It also has no documentation that honestly scopes the models to text-only input. The cited material covers function calling, multilingual support, edge runtimes, and safety classifiers, none of which address input modalities. This is a fair axis for a model family, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send images, audio, or documents to the model — or the docs honestly scope the model to text-only input
